name: 이마 질감 분석
algorithm: Forehead Texture — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes forehead skin texture for deepfake detection:

1. **Forehead영역추출**: The forehead region is segmented per frame — bounded by hairline, eyebrows, and temples. This region is geometrically normalized to compensate for head tilt and provide consistent texture analysis across frames.

2. **Multi-Scale텍스처분석**: Forehead texture is analyzed at multiple scales: macro (expression wrinkles, vein visibility), meso (pores, fine wrinkles), and micro (skin grain, peach fuzz). Natural foreheads exhibit characteristic texture at each scale. AI-generated foreheads often show texture quality that drops off at finer scales.

3. **Expression-텍스처상관**: Forehead texture changes predictably with expressions — horizontal wrinkles appear with brow raising (frontalis contraction), vertical wrinkles with brow furrowing (corrugator contraction). The method verifies that texture changes correlate correctly with detected expressions. Deepfakes may show expression without corresponding wrinkle formation.

4. **Sweat/SebumIndicator분석**: Real foreheads show subtle specular highlights from skin oils/perspiration, with characteristic spatial distribution. The method detects these physiological indicators — AI generators typically don't model skin surface moisture, producing either uniformly matte or uniformly shiny foreheads.

5. **시간적텍스처안정성**: Fine forehead texture (pore positions, stable wrinkles) should remain fixed across frames. The method tracks micro-texture consistency — frame-to-frame variations in pore patterns or shifting wrinkle positions indicate per-frame independent rendering by AI generators.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through forehead 텍스트ure analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
